lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Thanks for calling — this is AVA. Where can we take you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I need a car to O'Hare tomorrow, early. My flight's at six A-M.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Early flight — we'll get you there with room to spare. What's the pickup address, and how many riders?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Just me. Downtown, the Prudential building. I already checked and—

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Got it — one passenger, Prudential to O'Hare. For a six A-M flight I'd stage the car at three forty-five.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: A sedan to O'Hare is one-ninety, all in — no surge, no surprises. Want me to hold the car?

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Three forty-five A-M pickup, booked. Your confirmation and driver details are texting to you now.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Your driver will text when he's out front, Mr. Reyes. Safe travels.
